breakdown.description: A fully miscible binary polymer blend is typically associated with a single glass-transition temperature, whereas two distinct T_g values suggest phase separation / immiscibility.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the incorrect premise that the blend is 'fully miscible' despite DSC showing two distinct Tg values. The ground truth corrects this to 'immiscible.' Because the generated text did not fix this contradiction and instead preserved the original error, the inconsistency is not resolved.
